name: Shining Trapezohedron
text: [reaction] When you would pay the cost of a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Shining Trapezohedron: Instead, test [willpower] (X), where X is the card's resource cost. If you succeed, its resource cost is considered paid. If you fail, cancel the playing of that card without paying any of its costs (including its action cost). For the remainder of the round, you cannot play copies of that card.
text_cn: [reaction]在你将要支付一张[[法术]]卡牌的费用时，消耗闪耀的偏方三八面体：改为检定[willpower](X)，其中X为该卡牌的资源费用。如果你成功，其资源费用被视为你已支付。如果你失败，取消打出该卡牌，并且不支付其任何费用(包括其行动费用)。本轮接下来的时间里，你不能打出该卡名的卡牌。
